fields.title: City
fields.label: City
fields.subtitle: Geographic distribution of respondents across major Indian cities.
fields.caption: Mumbai and Delhi lead with 5 respondents each (22%), followed by Ahmedabad (22%), Lucknow (17%), and Bangalore (17%).
fields.how_to_read: A balanced geographic spread ensures regional biases don't skew the findings.

legend.label: Mumbai
legend.description: Financial capital with high exposure to investment products.

legend.label: Delhi
legend.description: Political and business hub with diverse investor profiles.

legend.label: Ahmedabad
legend.description: Traditional business community with strong gold affinity.

legend.label: Lucknow
legend.description: Emerging market with conservative investment tendencies.

legend.label: Bangalore
legend.description: Tech-savvy population open to digital investment platforms.

fields.title: Respondent Archetype
fields.label: Respondent Archetype
fields.subtitle: Behavioral segments derived from transcript analysis, not pre-set categories.
fields.caption: Cautious investors dominate (18/23, 78%) — split evenly between gold-focused (9) and growth-focused (9). Only 4 methodical stock investors and 1 growth-oriented outlier.
fields.how_to_read: High cautious-investor share signals need for safety-first messaging.
fields.calc_note: AI-classified from how the respondent talked about investments in the transcript.

legend.label: Cautious Gold Investor
legend.description: Prefers gold as a safe haven, skeptical of volatile assets.

legend.label: Cautious Growth Investor
legend.description: Seeks moderate returns but prioritizes capital protection.

legend.label: Methodical Stock Investor
legend.description: Disciplined equity investor with structured portfolio approach.

legend.label: Growth Oriented
legend.description: High-risk tolerance focused on aggressive returns.

fields.title: Risk Orientation
fields.label: Risk Orientation
fields.subtitle: Self-described attitude toward financial risk-taking.
fields.caption: Risk-neutral dominates (13/23, 57%), with 7 risk-averse (30%) and only 3 risk-seeking (13%). Confirms conservative audience.
fields.how_to_read: Neutral/averse majority needs proof of stability before yield claims.

legend.label: Risk Neutral
legend.description: Balances risk and return, avoids extremes.

legend.label: Risk Averse
legend.description: Prefers safety over potential returns.

legend.label: Risk Seeking
legend.description: Actively pursues high-risk, high-reward opportunities.

legend.label: High
legend.description: Extreme risk tolerance, uncommon in this sample.

fields.title: Life Stage
fields.label: Life Stage
fields.subtitle: Professional and personal phase influencing financial priorities.
fields.caption: Growing phase dominates (12/21, 57%) — early/mid-career respondents building wealth. Only 7 settled (33%) and 2 transitioning (10%).
fields.how_to_read: Growth-stage majority may prioritize liquidity over legacy.

legend.label: Growing
legend.description: Early/mid-career, actively accumulating assets.

legend.label: Settled
legend.description: Established professionals with stable portfolios.

legend.label: Transitioning
legend.description: Undergoing career or lifestyle changes affecting finances.

fields.title: Gold Allocation
fields.label: Gold Allocation
fields.subtitle: Current percentage of portfolio allocated to gold products.
fields.caption: Average 26% allocation (range 1-70%) — gold is non-trivial but rarely dominant. 5/22 (23%) allocate 40%+, suggesting niche heavy users.
fields.how_to_read: High allocations indicate gold-centric investors needing tailored messaging.

fields.title: Gold's Portfolio Role
fields.label: Gold's Portfolio Role
fields.subtitle: Primary function gold serves in the respondent's investment strategy.
fields.caption: Growth asset (9/23, 39%) and emotional insurance (6/23, 26%) dominate — gold isn't just a diversifier (3/23, 13%).
fields.how_to_read: Growth-focused roles may align better with yield messaging.
fields.calc_note: AI-classified from how the respondent described gold's purpose.

legend.label: Growth Asset
legend.description: Holds gold primarily for price appreciation potential.

legend.label: Emotional Insurance
legend.description: Values gold's psychological safety during market stress.

legend.label: Diversifier
legend.description: Uses gold to reduce overall portfolio volatility.

legend.label: Return Vehicle
legend.description: Actively trades gold for short-term profits.

legend.label: Safety Store
legend.description: Treats gold as a crisis hedge outside the financial system.

legend.label: Hedge
legend.description: Counters specific risks like inflation or currency weakness.

legend.label: Family Tradition
legend.description: Buys gold due to cultural/familial habits, not strategy.

fields.title: Investment Motivation
fields.label: Investment Motivation
fields.subtitle: Primary driver behind choosing gold investments.
fields.caption: Yield-seeking leads (11/22, 50%), outweighing diversification (5/22, 23%) and family security (4/22, 18%).
fields.how_to_read: Yield-focused majority aligns with product's value proposition.

legend.label: Yield Seeking
legend.description: Prioritizes returns over other attributes.

legend.label: Diversification
legend.description: Seeks uncorrelated assets to balance risk.

legend.label: Family Security
legend.description: Views gold as intergenerational wealth transfer.

legend.label: Long Term Stability
legend.description: Values gold's historical preservation of purchasing power.

fields.title: Gold Behavior — SGB Awareness
fields.label: Gold Behavior — SGB Awareness
fields.subtitle: Measures awareness of Sovereign Gold Bonds (SGBs) among respondents to gauge market penetration and education gaps.
fields.caption: Only 10% (2/22) show high SGB awareness, while 36% (8/22) have medium awareness — weak adoption signals poor marketing or product complexity risks.
fields.how_to_read: If 'low' or 'none' dominate, it indicates urgent need for awareness campaigns to drive SGB uptake.
fields.calc_note: Value derived from self-reported awareness levels in survey responses, categorized by researchers.

legend.label: Medium
legend.description: Recognizes SGBs but lacks detailed knowledge — may need nudges to convert to buyers.

legend.label: Low
legend.description: Vaguely aware of SGBs but unclear on mechanics — high education barrier exists.

legend.label: None
legend.description: No awareness of SGBs — represents untapped market segment requiring foundational outreach.

legend.label: Partial
legend.description: Knows some SGB features (e.g., gold-linked) but misses key benefits like interest payouts.

legend.label: High
legend.description: Fully understands SGB features and advantages — prime targets for immediate conversion.

sections.title: Gold Allocation Distribution
sections.subtitle: Current percentage of portfolio allocated to gold products.
sections.how_to_read: Right-skewed distribution indicates most allocate under 30%, with a few heavy users at 50%+.

fields.title: Route Comprehension
fields.label: Route Comprehension
fields.subtitle: Which product explanation route the respondent understood better.
fields.caption: 21/22 (95%) grasped both routes — only 1 understood Route1 alone. Demonstrates effective dual-path communication.
fields.how_to_read: Near-universal dual comprehension reduces need for route-specific education.

legend.label: Both
legend.description: Understood ownership-led and yield-led explanations equally.

legend.label: Route1
legend.description: Only comprehended the ownership-focused narrative.

fields.title: Yield Understanding
fields.label: Yield Understanding
fields.subtitle: Depth of grasp on the digital gold yield mechanism.
fields.caption: Only 7/22 (32%) achieved clear understanding — 15 (68%) partially grasped it. Yield mechanics need simplification.
fields.how_to_read: Majority partial comprehension risks misaligned expectations post-purchase.
fields.calc_note: AI-classified from explanation attempts in transcript.

legend.label: Partial
legend.description: Understood basic yield premise but missed operational details.

legend.label: Clear
legend.description: Could accurately explain how yields are generated and paid.

fields.title: Liquidity Perception
fields.label: Liquidity Perception
fields.subtitle: How respondents perceived the product's liquidity features.
fields.caption: 18/22 (82%) recognized liquidity as a key feature — only 3 (14%) miscast it as long-term investment. Strong liquidity positioning.
fields.how_to_read: High liquidity awareness supports positioning as a flexible holding.
fields.calc_note: AI-classified from discussion of redemption timelines.

legend.label: Liquid
legend.description: Correctly identified easy redemption as a feature.

legend.label: Investment
legend.description: Mistakenly viewed product as long-term locked holding.

legend.label: Yes
legend.description: Affirmed liquidity but without nuanced understanding.

fields.title: Emotional Response
fields.label: Emotional Response
fields.subtitle: Affective reaction to the digital gold concept.
fields.caption: Neutral dominates (14/22, 64%) with 7 positive (32%) and only 1 negative (5%). No strong aversion, but limited excitement.
fields.how_to_read: Neutral majority suggests need for more emotionally compelling hooks.
fields.calc_note: AI-classified from tone and language used discussing the concept.

legend.label: Neutral
legend.description: No strong positive or negative feelings about the concept.

legend.label: Positive
legend.description: Expressed enthusiasm or excitement about features.

legend.label: Negative
legend.description: Raised concerns or skepticism about viability.

fields.title: Advocacy Potential
fields.label: Advocacy Potential
fields.subtitle: Likelihood to recommend based on initial concept reaction.
fields.caption: 13/22 (59%) passive, 5 (23%) promoters, 4 (18%) unclear. Weak organic advocacy — needs stronger differentiators.
fields.how_to_read: High passive share indicates 'nice-to-have' not 'must-have' perception.
fields.calc_note: AI-inferred from language used describing the product to others.

legend.label: Passive
legend.description: Would use but not actively recommend — lacks compelling hooks.

legend.label: Promoter
legend.description: Enthusiastic enough to tell peers — sees clear advantages.

legend.label: Unclear
legend.description: Insufficient signal to classify advocacy stance.

sections.title: Comprehension Score Distribution
sections.subtitle: Numeric assessment of how well respondents understood the product.
sections.how_to_read: Scores cluster around 7-8 — decent but not deep understanding.
sections.calc_note: AI-rated from explanation accuracy in transcript.

fields.title: Route Preference
fields.label: Route Preference
fields.subtitle: Which communication route resonated more strongly.
fields.caption: Near-even split — 11 Route1 (52%), 10 Route2 (48%). No clear winner; audience segments may drive preference.
fields.how_to_read: Balanced split suggests need for both routes in market materials.
fields.calc_note: Directly reported when forced to choose.

legend.label: Route1
legend.description: Preferred the ownership-led narrative emphasizing safety.

legend.label: Route2
legend.description: Preferred the yield-led narrative emphasizing returns.

sections.title: Route 1 Appeal Distribution
sections.subtitle: Rating of how appealing the safety/ownership narrative was.
sections.how_to_read: 7-8 scores dominate — solid but not exceptional resonance.

sections.title: Route 2 Appeal Distribution
sections.subtitle: Rating of how appealing the yield/returns narrative was.
sections.how_to_read: Similar to Route1 but slightly tighter clustering around 7-8.

fields.title: Crypto Association Impact
fields.label: Crypto Association Impact
fields.subtitle: How CoinDCX's crypto background affects trust in this gold product.
fields.caption: 14/22 (64%) see conditional impact — depends on safeguards. Only 6 (27%) outright negative. Crypto ties aren't a universal trust barrier.
fields.how_to_read: Majority open to crypto affiliation if proper safeguards are proven.
fields.calc_note: AI-classified from discussion of platform credibility.

legend.label: Conditional
legend.description: Willing to trust if gold operations are ring-fenced from crypto.

legend.label: Negative
legend.description: Crypto association reduces trust in gold product integrity.

legend.label: Neutral
legend.description: No effect — evaluates gold product on standalone merits.

legend.label: Positive
legend.description: Crypto expertise increases confidence in digital product execution.

fields.title: CoinDCX Trust Level
fields.label: CoinDCX Trust Level
fields.subtitle: Baseline trust in CoinDCX as a platform provider.
fields.caption: 14/22 (64%) medium trust, 7 (32%) low, only 1 (5%) high. Trust deficit is real but not absolute.
fields.how_to_read: Medium-trust majority needs proof points to overcome skepticism.
fields.calc_note: AI-classified from language used discussing the platform.

legend.label: Medium
legend.description: Some confidence but needs more proof of reliability.

legend.label: Low

legend.label: High

sections.title: Adoption Likelihood Distribution
sections.subtitle: Self-reported likelihood to adopt the product in current form.
sections.how_to_read: Clustered around 6-7 — decent intent but room to improve appeal.
